free_tier_limits: Developer plan: 2,000 requests per day and 3 requests per second. DeFi Positions, Wallet Portfolio Chart, and Wallet P&L endpoints are capped at 25% of the plan quota and are not covered by overages.
rate_limits: Plan-based: Developer 3 RPS, Builder 10 RPS, Startup 25 RPS, and Enterprise 1,000+ RPS. Their quotas are 2,000/day, 250,000/month, 1,000,000/month, and 2,500,000+/month, respectively. Responses include limit, remaining-quota, and reset headers.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: incorrect; current pricing confirms 2K/day, 3 RPS, and the 25% endpoint cap: https://zerion.io/api. rate_limits: incorrect; pricing publishes plan quotas/RPS, while docs confirm plan dependence, response headers, and HTTP 429: https://zerion.io/api and https://developers.zerion.io/rate-limits. example: incorrect; the official endpoint uses HTTP Basic authentication with the API key as username and an empty password and documents the 200 response schema: https://developers.zerion.io/api-reference/wallets/get-wallet-fungible-positions.
